constraints.description: Every process segment is assigned exactly once.
Assigned robot provides the required tool and capabilities.
constraints.evidence_boundary: Declared capability compatibility, not physical validation.

constraints.description: The A1 reachability oracle marks the edge feasible.
constraints.evidence_boundary: Proxy or declared kinematics; not full collision-free execution.

constraints.description: Segments of one parent curve respect segment_index and process direction.
All predecessor segments complete before the dependent segment starts.
Free, same-robot, explicit-boundary and non-splittable semantics are enforced.
constraints.evidence_boundary: Declared process rule supplied by the instance.

constraints.description: The selected traversal respects forward, reverse or either direction.
Segment execution occurs inside its release and due window.
constraints.evidence_boundary: Configured time windows, not measured factory cycle time.

constraints.description: A robot executes at most one segment at any time.
Concurrent use does not exceed shared resource capacity.
Edges intersecting a declared no-go proxy are forbidden.
constraints.evidence_boundary: Not a complete robot-fixture collision guarantee.

objectives.description: Variance of robot assigned execution loads.
